description: PictoPal is a technology-rich emergent-literacy curriculum developed by Amina Cviko and colleagues that integrates computer-based writing activities with authentic classroom uses of children's printed texts.
title: PictoPal

description: A 29-question pictorial assessment developed by Arzu Ergişi Birgül and colleagues to measure preschool children's knowledge of time concepts.
title: Pictorial Form

description: A researcher-designed picture-based spelling assessment with phonological-plausibility scoring, developed by Geers and Hayes for adolescents with prelingual deafness and cochlear implants.
title: Picture Spelling Test with phonological plausibility scoring

description: A 72-item nurse knowledge test developed by Barbara Pieper and Karen Zulkowski assessing pressure-injury prevention, staging, and wound description.
title: Pieper–Zulkowski Pressure Injury Knowledge Test (PZ-PIKT), 2021 updated version

description: A question-level GCSE mathematics mock-exam results dataset extracted from the Pinpoint Learning platform and collected from teacher-uploaded assessments.
title: Pinpoint Learning mock-exam dataset of 119,034 UK students across 13 national-level mock exams

description: A standardized group mental-ability test consisting of six tests for school children ages 6–16, developed by Rudolf Pintner and normed on more than 3,000 children with percentile norms.
title: Pintner's Mental Survey

description: PIPSE is a web-based project-investment problem-solving and assessment environment developed by Gálvez et al.
title: PIPSE

description: Pirate Math is a one-to-one mathematics tutoring programme for third-grade students with calculation and word-problem difficulties, delivered through structured sessions using counting-up and missing-number strategies with a treasure-map reward system.
title: Pirate Math

description: A research dataset assembled by Nico Andersen et al.
title: PISA 2015 German reading constructed-response dataset for fairness analysis

description: A Programme for International Student Assessment 2018 dataset linking student-, school-, and country-level measures of intercultural education, teacher attitudes, and psychosocial outcomes across 58 countries, produced by the OECD.
title: PISA 2018 dataset on intercultural education and student psychosocial outcomes

description: A PISA student questionnaire module administered by the OECD to measure 15-year-old students' learning conditions and experiences during COVID-19 school closures.
title: PISA 2022 Global Crises Module (GCM) student questionnaire

description: PISA-VET is an OECD-led large-scale assessment of occupation-specific and employability skills among learners nearing completion of vocational education and training programmes.
title: PISA-VET

description: A proposed PISA-VET assessment framework that evaluates near-completion vocational students across representative occupational skills and transversal employability skills for workforce readiness.
title: PISA-VET dual-domain assessment framework combining occupation-specific and employability skills

description: PIVOT is a three-stage pedagogy-guided generative video tutoring framework developed by Xinchen Ma et al.
title: PIVOT

description: Pixton is an online comic-strip creation platform developed by Pixton that enables users to create, personalize, share, and download visual comic materials.
title: Pixton
